messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doctor should check progress at regular visits"
set: ["doctor should check progress at regular visits", "doctor should check growth at regular visits", "your doctor will need to check your progress on a regular basis", "use next dose at regular time", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening at regular intervals", "take your next dose at the regular time", "ask doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting and at regular intervals afterwards", "breastfeeding individuals should tell doctor", "therapy should be initiated at 2.5 mg", "families and caregivers should stay in regular contact with the prescriber", "check with doctor or pharmacist for nighttime dose", "keep all follow-up visits with healthcare provider", "have regular skin checks", "dosing should continue for at least 6 weeks", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not", "check with your doctor or pharmacist before combining medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
